name: Wrinkled Hornbill
rangeDescription: Malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Brightly-colored medium-large hornbill. Both sexes are black with bare facial skin, blobby throat “pouches”, yellowish tails, and casqued bills.

name: Malabar Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Southwestern india (western ghats from goa to kerala)
description: Large elegant pearl-gray pigeon with dark-brown wings. There is a broad gray band across the end of the tail that is especially obvious in flight.

name: Long-toed Stint
rangeDescription: Northeastern palearctic; winters southeastern asia to philippines and australia
description: Tiny and slender “peep” of inland and coastal wetlands, where it is often found in well-vegetated areas such as fields and flooded meadows. Unlike most other small sandpipers in the region, this species has a distinctly long-winged and slender-bodied appearance.

name: Waigeo Shrikethrush
rangeDescription: Waigeo (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: Learn about Little Shrikethrush (Waigeo): explore photos, sounds, and observations collected by birders around the world.

name: African Hawk-Eagle
rangeDescription: Woodland and savanna of sub-saharan africa
description: A medium-sized, boldly-patterned, dark-and-white eagle. In flight the underwing is brown and white with a thick black hind edge, and the tail is mostly pale gray with a thick dark bar at the end; these combine to give it a unique plumage pattern in flight.

name: Baltimore Oriole
rangeDescription: Eastern north america (southern canada to southern usa); winters to northern south america
description: The common oriole in the eastern U.S., wintering to northern South America. Adult males are stunning: bright orange with a black head and bold white wingbar.

name: Puerto Rican Emerald
rangeDescription: Puerto rico (primarily in montane forest)
description: A lively inhabitant of most wooded habitats, coffee plantations, and gardens. The long-tailed male is distinctive in being entirely iridescent green, although can radiate blue at certain angles and lighting.

name: Apurimac Spinetail
rangeDescription: Andes of southern peru (bosque de ampay region of apurímac)
description: Small, long-tailed bird found locally in humid montane forest in the Apurimac valley. Dark slaty gray with a rusty red cap and wings.

name: Golden Parakeet
rangeDescription: Northeastern brazil (northern maranhão and pará)
description: Remarkable Brazilian parakeet whose golden-yellow plumage and green flight feathers match the national flag. Found in humid forest, old second growth, and seasonally flooded forests.

name: Neumann's Warbler
rangeDescription: Montane forest of eastern democratic republic of the congo, southwestern uganda, and western rwanda
description: Unusual short-tailed and big-headed warbler. The most obvious marks are the bold black, white, and olive-green stripes on the head.

name: American Avocet
rangeDescription: Southern canada to northern mexico; winters southern usa to costa rica and cuba
description: Distinctive large shorebird with a long, thin, upturned bill. Look for bold black-and-white wings and long blue-gray legs.

name: Palau Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Lowlands of palau (western caroline islands)
description: A reddish-brown owl with a large rounded head, pale whitish eyebrows, and no ear tufts. Upperparts spotted with black-tipped white spots.

name: Chestnut-bellied Malkoha
rangeDescription: Southern myanmar, southern thailand, malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Large, rather ungainly cuckoo; clambers about in the middle and upper levels of lowland forests and edges as it forages. Glossy green above, gray below and on head, with neon-orange skin around the eye, chestnut-orange belly and undertail coverts, greenish-yellow bill, and white-tipped green tail.

name: Bronze-winged Jacana
rangeDescription: Lowlands of india to southwestern china, southeastern asia, sumatra, and java
description: Gangly inhabitant of well-vegetated wetlands, especially ponds and lakes with floating vegetation. Adult’s dark neck and bright white eyebrows are unmistakable.

name: Ross's Turaco
rangeDescription: Riparian forest and woodland of central africa
description: Spectacular purple turaco with a yellow bill and face and a puffy red crest. Shows large crimson wing patches in flight.

name: Purple Indigobird
rangeDescription: Southwestern angola; kenya, northern and northeastern tanzania, southeastern democratic republic of the congo, southern and eastern zambia, malawi, western mozambique, northeastern botswana, zimbabwe, and northeastern south africa (limpopo and mpumalanga)
description: Nest parasite that lays its eggs in the nests of Jameson’s Firefinch. Breeding males are glossy purplish-black, with a pale brownish panel in the wings, while females and non-breeding males are streaky and brown on the back and pale below, with a bold facial pattern.

name: White-striped Forest Rail
rangeDescription: Montane forest of western new guinea (bird's head peninsula)
description: A medium-sized rail of mid-mountane forest on New Guinea’s Bird’s Head. Chestnut body, dark wings and back with white markings on.

name: Rufous-bellied Bush-Tyrant
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of southern peru (pasco) to western bolivia
description: Subtly patterned reddish-brown flycatcher of high-elevation montane forests. Perches upright, often on the tops of snags or bushes around forest edges and clearings.

name: Bahama Oriole
rangeDescription: Andros (bahamas); formerly also great and little abaco, where extirpated in 1990s
description: A sleek inhabitant of wooded areas that will venture into gardens and parks in search of flowers and fruit; prefers areas with palms. The adult is distinctive with a black back, head, and chest contrasting with a bright yellow to yellow-orange belly, rump, and shoulders.

name: White-masked Antbird
rangeDescription: Northeastern peru (lower río pastaza and lower río morona)
description: Handsome antbird known only from a small area in northeastern Peru. Restricted to lowland rainforest in areas where the soil is sandy.
